correctness.rationale: The conditional mixture follows from weighted Cayley tree enumeration after contracting a prescribed path. The exact tail coefficient polynomial has endpoint coefficients of opposite signs for every interior increment after the first; multiplication by q+pz cannot add sign reversals. The terminal Hamiltonian-path case is direct, and all means are strictly increasing. Exact rational Prüfer checks for sizes 3..7 and tail coefficients through size 30 passed.

value.rationale: Complete qualitative order classification for three naturally marked vertices in a uniform random tree: the first distance increase gives stochastic dominance, all others exhibit precisely one opposing tail crossing despite a monotone mean. The fact characterizes a structural tradeoff between increased probability of lying on a geodesic and loss of outside attachments and does not follow from marginal means or previous endpoint regression.
